item.title: The Big Erewash Sleep Out 2026 for The Canaan Trust - 10th April - Erewash Sound
item.description: The 2026 Big Erewash Sleep Out in aid of The Canaan Trust will be staged on Friday 10th April.

item.title: Ockbrook blood donor with NEO blood urges more people to donate - Erewash Sound
item.description: A lifelong donor from Derby who has the NEO blood that can help critically ill babies is urging more people to give blood and says "there is no easier way to save a life".Nigel Vaughan, 70, is preparing to make his milestone 250th donation in April and is proud that his B negative blood can help the tiniest patients.

item.title: Family of man murdered by intoxicated pub customer share disappointment over venue's late alcohol sales permit - Erewash Sound
item.description: The mother and girlfriend of a man murdered outside a Derbyshire pub have shared their disappointment at the venue being allowed to serve alcohol to 2am once again.

item.title: Derbyshire charity ‘fairy godmother’ founder receives prestigious King’s Award - Erewash Sound
item.description: A Derbyshire charity which helps families facing short and uncertain futures to make memories received the King’s Award for Voluntary Service at a special event surrounded by 90 guests.

item.title: Transport Secretary tasks HS2 with reducing construction time and cost to taxpayers - Erewash Sound
item.description: The Transport Secretary has tasked HS2 Ltd to explore options to remove complexity that could cut billions in costs and reduce delays for the project.

item.title: Historic pottery manufacturer launches campaign to save the business - Erewash Sound
item.description: Bosses at historic Derbyshire pottery manufacturer Denby have launched a campaign to save the company.Earlier this month, the 217-year-old business filed a notice of intent to appoint administrators citing soaring costs combined with low consumer confidence.

item.title: Man who fought in pub brawl and attacked police officers jailed for more than five years - Erewash Sound
item.description: A man who fought with others in a pub brawl and later attacked police officers has been jailed for more than five years.

item.title: Councillor claims the lack of NHS support for armed forces veterans is a “massive, massive disgrace" - Erewash Sound
item.description: The lack of NHS support for armed forces veterans is a “massive, massive disgrace” according to one Derbyshire councillor.Reform UK’s Councillor Tony Wilson, who is Derbyshire County Council’s armed forces champion, made the comments at a health scrutiny meeting on Monday 23rd March.

item.title: Road Safety Trust celebrates a decade of impact and over £13 million awarded in grants - Erewash Sound
item.description: An independent impact study published today to mark The Road Safety Trust’s tenth anniversary will outline how the charity’s funding has helped build the evidence base for safer roads across the UK.
